description: Turns on a design’s share link and returns it, with the access the person chose: «view» (anyone with the link looks) or «edit» (anyone signed in edits). Use it ONLY when the person asked in this conversation for a link to send: ask the person first which access they want; never share on your own. Only the owner can share; the link stays the same if already on and can be turned off in Paletoo (Share). The design does not change.

access.description: «view»: anyone with the link can look; «edit»: anyone with it can edit, once signed in — as the person asked

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

name: share_design
title: Share a design
